entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Papyrus 21, designated by siglum 𝔓21, is an early copy of the New Testament in Greek. It is a papyrus manuscript of the Gospel of Matthew, it contains only Matthew 12:24–26.32–33. The manuscript paleographically had been assigned to the early 4th century.
